payload.text: gtools liberator brew-leg proof (issue 0057; was hold 17, released 30 Oct as its conditions are met: Gtools cut, its tap present, gtools enabled brew-only on gyges and kovacs at Molt-matts 5eb59f5). molt install gtools must tap over ssh and install, and molt doctor must report Homebrew's gtools as what PATH runs, on kovacs through kovacs-sysadm and on gyges when reachable. rhadamanth-sysadm sends the gtools lines from kovacs's first molt upgrade.
